parts.text: Evaluate a tele-cardiology AI screening solution designed for Puskesmas primary care centers in West Java, Indonesia. Provide a VDHIC v1.25 analysis covering SaMD classification, SATUSEHAT FHIR requirements, and BPJS Kapitasi alignment.

Review an AI Chest X-Ray diagnostic software for Tuberculosis screening in regional Indonesian hospitals. Focus on Governance Spine SaMD risk tier, UU PDP data localization compliance, and ICD-10 / LOINC coding standards.
Provide a VDHIC v1.25 review report for an autonomous AI diabetic retinopathy screening system seeking entry into the Kemenkes Regulatory Sandbox.
